Om Namo Devye – Namaskar | Mahalaxmi Mantra
Celebrate the auspicious occasion of Varaha Lakshmi Vrata Utsav 2026 with the divine and soulful voice of Anuradha Paudwal.
Listen to this powerful Mahalaxmi Mantra and seek the blessings of Goddess Lakshmi for wealth, prosperity, peace, happiness and abundance.
Om Namo Devye Namaskar
Mahalaxmi Mantra
Varaha Lakshmi Vrata Utsav 2026
Lakshmi Devi Bhakti Song
